text:
elena: kicking off Quorra LoRA bring-up on int8 this morning. focused quick-eval uses invoices + tiny table prompts.

mike: did you run tokenizer remap? last time Quorra split currency tokens oddly.

elena: ran align and a quick diff. cmd: 
```
python infra/token_align.py --src models/base-q/tokenizer.json --dst customers/quorra/tokenizer.json --out tmp/q_token_map.json
```

ci-bot: queued: smoke/1758009999-quorra-int8-invoice (priority: high) :rocket:

josiah: quick peek at outputs — totals mostly good but saw 2/40 cases with cents dropped ("$5.00" -> "$5") and one case with swapped cents ("$21.49" -> "$21.94").

tara: Quorra requires exact cents for billing. this will be a blocker unless we fix for canary.

elena: initial quant config: int8, group_size=128, per_channel=true, kv_prefill=true. i'll try kv_prefill=false and act-order=symmetric next.

mike: also try my token-glue branch (token-glue/quorra-currency) that merges adjacent currency subtokens in decode.

ci-bot: smoke started -> smoke/1758009999-quorra-int8-invoice: 0/40 complete.

elena: running quick eval: 
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model base-q --lora customers/quorra/quorra-lora-v1 --quant int8 --prompts eval_packs/quorra_invoices.json --out /tmp/quorra_eval.json --batch-size 4
```

elena: mid-run (20/40): dumped raw token ids for failing sample #7. looks like tokenizer split: "$21.49" -> ["$21", ".49"]. extractor expects single token.

josiah: that's a tokenization mismatch, not pure quant. fastest fix is postprocess glue for currency patterns. add a unit test vector.

tara: customer ok with a 5% canary if invoice routes fallback to fp16. include that in rollout notes.

elena: plan: 1) apply token-glue postprocess + unit test; 2) rerun quick-eval; 3) if pass, deploy 5% canary with enforced fp16 fallback on invoice route; 4) attach artifacts and failing samples to infra/rollout/1758009999.

ci-bot: smoke complete: 40/40. summary: 37 pass, 3 tokenization-format regressions. artifacts: /ci/artifacts/smoke/1758009999/summary.json :white_check_mark:

mike: i'll open PR for token-glue and add a currency-regression test to the eval pack.

josiah: also add a lint check to warn if customer tokenizers split currency regexes.

tara: i'll draft CS note and timeline. please ping when PR lands so i can confirm with Quorra.

elena: thanks all 12 closing thread after PR merges and CI green.
